Description
Oxford Brookes is one of the UK's leading modern universities and enjoys an international reputation for teaching excellence and innovation, as well as strong links with businessand industry. Based in Oxford, England, it comprises four Faculties: Business, Health andLife Sciences, Humanities and Social Sciences and Technology, Design and Environment.
